name: Calvin — supporting marker doodles and transparent textures
source: Original code-native vector drawings made for this portfolio; no external assets, fonts or scripts.

common.accessibility: Use alt="" for decorative image elements or aria-hidden="true" for inline SVG. Decorative layers must have pointer-events:none.
common.placement: Use only in dedicated margin/edge slots. Hero, project opener and contact may use clusters. Keep case-study reading areas calm. Do not place strokes across copy, faces, important project UI or controls.
common.motion: Static by default. An optional one-time reveal may follow existing reduced-motion and manual pause preferences. No permanent spinning or repeated redraw.
common.notes: Widths below are suggestions in CSS pixels; height remains auto. Natural dimensions include breathing room. Do not use every asset in every section. Mask tinting uses alpha, including the lighter secondary strokes.

assets.role: A short hand-drawn baseline below one selected statement; reserve vertical space and keep the strokes below the glyphs.
Friendly software-testing doodle near the hero or opener edge; decorative metaphor, not evidence of a found vulnerability.
Learning/growth accent near the About/contact boundary; keep clear of the existing cat's dock.
One hand-drawn coding reference near the hero or project-opener margin; avoid turning the whole page into a terminal theme.
Small edge accent for an existing screenshot/photo/process note, with no overlap on evidence or body copy.

note: Daftar ini mengikuti berkas yang benar-benar dipakai halaman; gambar yang tidak terpakai sudah dikeluarkan dari repository.
